method: Country-specific piecewise annual histories using institutional continuity plus temporally gated training, coaching, development and competition-system evidence.
evidence_rules: Turkey's 1923 organised-governance and 1953 federation milestones anchor history; current national centres, coach courses and 2026 calendar are not backcast.
Cyprus pre-1955 tennis/federation history anchors tradition; later ITF/Tennis Europe membership and National Tennis Centre are gated from their actual years.
Modern Cyprus federation observations are treated as partial association context rather than proof of all tennis activity across the entire island.
Programme capacity and tournament listings are not equated with participation or player outcomes.
Competition quality uses organised opportunity/system depth, not one famous player's peak.
No held-out validation ranking is used for tuning.
